title: True Vanilla
description: I’ve tweaked a few textures just to make the gameplay feel a bit smoother.
body:
![..](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b381bbc63f2ab41fab8d8502a4688cd4d73492a8.png)

**I’ve tweaked a few textures just to make the gameplay feel a bit smoother.**

Designed to keep the classic vanilla feel while making everything look a lot cleaner. It’s easy on the eyes, making it perfect for both chill survival and fast-paced server games.

**Changelog**

**Fast Better Grass** — cleaner and smoother looking grass landscapes.

**Item Tweaks** — polished textures for several vanilla items.

**Short & Detailed Swords** — smaller models for better screen visibility during combat.

**Compact Shield & Totem** — shrunk down so they don't block your view.

**Sleek Dark Mode** — a clean, eye-friendly dark theme for the UI.

**Minimalist Crosshair** — a smaller, more precise crosshair for better aiming.

**Night Vision** — clearer visibility in dark areas and caves.

**Block Enhancements** — subtle improvements to various block textures.

**Crop Growth Indicators** — clearly shows when your crops are fully grown and ready to harvest.

![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28d136ad6100b6722b806712fae1342862afd01d.jpeg)
